log.name: desktop-skip-focus
log.body:
Skip to content
Harbor Bench
Neighborhood furniture repair
Request an estimate
Good furniture.
More life.

A chair that wobbles. A drawer that sticks. A table with a little too much history. Let’s see what a careful repair can do.

Request an estimate
Chairs, tables & cabinets. Built to be used again.
Keep the character.
Lose the wobble.
A sound joint makes all the difference.
Chairs

Loose joints, uneven legs and tired seats. Bring back the steady feeling of a chair you trust.

Tables

Wobbly bases, split timber and worn surfaces. Care for the place where everyday life happens.

Cabinets

Sticking drawers, sagging doors and loose hinges. Small adjustments can make a familiar piece work well again.

Tell us about
your piece.

Start with what it is and what isn’t working. You don’t need to know the name of the wood or the right word for the joint.

Repair starts with a closer look.

A description helps frame the work. A firm price would follow an inspection, with the repair agreed before tools touch your furniture.

All fields are required. This is a local demo: nothing is sent to the workshop.

What needs a repair?
Chair
Table
Cabinet
Your email
What would you like repaired?

Tell us what’s loose, damaged or not working. Approximate size and material help, if you know them.

Request an estimate

This demo does not send or save your details.

Harbor Bench · Furniture worth keeping.

Neighborhood craft. A little more life.
